use: context only: the decision value (DV) is priced with a league-average runner on purpose, and the execution residual (ER) is realized minus that expectation; neither reads these columns

runner.definition: the share of that season's runners on the Savant sprint speed leaderboard (10 or more competitive runs) who are slower, runners at his exact speed (himself included) counted as half, times 100, rounded to the nearest whole number
runner.row: runners.{mlbam} = [percentile, sprint speed ft/s, competitive runs]

catcher.definition: the catcher's average pop time to second base that season, seconds, from the Savant catcher throwing leaderboard; the catcher is the one the MLB feed names behind the plate on the steal's own event
catcher.row: catchers.{mlbam} = [pop time to second, s (null when the board has none), stolen-base attempts on the board, name]

key: a steal row joins on season, then in_id (runner) and game_pk:ab (catcher)

notes.no_sprint_board: no Savant sprint speed leaderboard on file for {season}
notes.runner_not_listed: not on the {season} Savant sprint speed leaderboard, which lists runners with {floor} or more competitive runs
notes.no_season: no catcher context on file for {season}
notes.no_catcher: the MLB feed names no catcher on this attempt
notes.no_pop: no pop time for this catcher on the {season} Savant catcher throwing leaderboard
